propositions: Lizard complexity analyzer adapter must be implemented in src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/ and calculate true per-function cyclomatic complexity across ~25 languages via imported lizard library.
Missing metrics extra dependency must be caught as OptionalDependencyError from guard_import and return Unavailable with reason and accruing_since, not bare ImportError.
Analyzer must populate AnalyzerResult.complexity with per-file/aggregate CCN and optionally token/parameter counts by running lizard over the scan root.
Implementation must be exercised on Python fixtures and at least one non-Python language fixture to verify polyglot parsing capability.
Guard-absent path must be tested to verify OptionalDependencyError handling converts to Unavailable; real lizard path must execute polyglot E2E with deterministic CCN values.
